title: Measurement properties of patient-reported outcome measures used in third molar surgery: a COSMIN-based systematic review
html: This systematic review was performed to evaluate the development and measurement properties of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) used in patients undergoing third molar surgery, in accordance with the Consensus-based Standards for the Selection of Health Measurement Instruments (COSMIN). The review followed the COSMIN guideline for systematic reviews of PROMs (version 2.0) and is reported in accordance with the PRISMA-COSMIN 2024 statement. A comprehensive systematic search was conducted in MEDLINE (via PubMed), Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, LIVIVO, Epistemonikos, and Google Scholar.
